target: Primer Tooltip supplementary hover/focus help and hidden-content caution
observed_behavior: Primer's Tooltip product page describes additional context attached to interactive controls that appears on mouse hover or keyboard focus. Its prominent usage warning advises treating tooltips as a last resort for communicating important information because the content is hidden initially and users may have little or no indication it exists. The page refers readers to alternatives; this B5 observation records only the warning and the existence of that reference rather than importing the linked alternative page.
context: W07 Stage B5 K3; authorized Primer product page section: Tooltip overview; Usage Warning; React default example. Explanatory product API/design documentation within Primer only.
limitations: The last-resort warning is Primer first-party design guidance, not universally binding WCAG or HTML law.
Linked tooltip-alternative guidance is outside B5's four permitted pages and has not been inspected or used as evidence.
A tooltip hidden by default should not be represented as the sole reliably discoverable mechanism for critical tasks without separate evidence.
The documentation statement that hover or focus displays a tooltip is not a witnessed browser, keyboard or assistive-technology test.
